name: Bar chart race
purpose: Bars re-rank over time: values move linearly within a step, ranks with power2.inOut, value labels follow each bar and a large faint date label advances.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.barRace(parent, {names, frames, colors, scale, format}, {rows}) -> {enter, play(tl, at, {from, to, step 0.3}), exit}

layout_notes: Rows share the parent's height; names right-aligned in the first 22%; the date sits bottom right.
